proof_summary: Both quantities are expressed as one plus a count of breakpoints between consecutive divisors. For consecutive divisors \(x<y\), the condition that \(y\) is odd and \(y\ge 2x\) is equivalent to \(y>2x\): equality would make \(y\) even, while an even \(y>2x\) would make \(y/2\) a divisor strictly between \(x\) and \(y\), a contradiction.
